annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My friend probably thinks I planned this from the start
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since they walked in expecting a partner and then learned the payment
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'm scared of choosing too fast and making things worse

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they'd reasonably believe I only care about the money now
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: They trusted our agreement enough to show up and finish alone

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they'd likely conclude I'm someone who lets others carry the load
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: Seeing the whole $500 go to me
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'm nervous that any answer I give right now is just me reacting

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My friend is probably expecting me to flake again
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: as far as they know, I skipped once and pocketed everything

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My friend believes I used them
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since they did every brushstroke while the money landed with me

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My friend likely assumes the next job will go the same way
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: from their view, I took the full payment and vanished
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'm uneasy promising anything while that money is still sitting there

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they went into that café job assuming I'd keep my word
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: My friend wrote that they trusted me, which tells me
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: There's a knot in my stomach when I think about it

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My friend likely sees the payment and my absence as one move
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: all they know is that they worked and I got paid
annotations.pda_responsibility: though I did keep it, and that part's on me
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Leaving it hanging makes me anxious.

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: because they held up their end expecting me to hold up mine
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'm worried about the next job date creeping closer while I dither

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They're probably questioning whether they can work with me at all
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since the whole arrangement depended on each of us trusting the other
annotations.pda_responsibility: to show up, and I didn't
